children: Scandinavian Enviro Systems AB (publ) (“Enviro” or the “Company”), which has been undergoing company reorganisation since 27 February 2026, hereby announces that the Company has today, in consultation with the reorganisation administrator, applied to the Gothenburg District Court for a further extension of the company reorganisation up to and including 27 February 2027. The extension of the reorganisation period is necessary in order to hold the plan hearing at which the creditors will vote on the Company’s proposed reorganisation plan, to enable the District Court thereafter to consider whether to confirm the plan, and to complete the company reorganisation.

Enviro’s company reorganisation was granted by the Gothenburg District Court on 27 February 2026. The company reorganisation has since been extended twice, most recently up to and including 27 November 2026. On 9 November 2026, the Company published a revised proposed reorganisation plan (the “

”), and on 18 November 2026, the Company applied to the Gothenburg District Court for plan negotiations. The plan hearing will be held on 9 December 2026 at 09:15 CET at the Gothenburg District Court, Ullevigatan 15, SE-411 39 Gothenburg, Sweden. Further information about the Reorganisation Plan and instructions for participating in the plan hearing are available in previously published press releases on the Company’s website, www.envirosystems.se.
The purpose of the extension is to enable the plan hearing and the plan negotiations to be held within the reorganisation period, and the company reorganisation to be completed thereafter.
N.B. The English text is an in-house translation of the original Swedish text. Should there be any disparities between the Swedish and the English text, the Swedish text shall prevail.
